name: Death
title: The Unbeatable Foe
description: An anthropomorphic personification of death from wizarding folklore, said to have grudgingly granted the three Deathly Hallows to the Peverell brothers after they cheated it by conjuring a bridge over a raging river.

name: Antioch Peverell
title: The Eldest Brother
description: The eldest of the three Peverell brothers, who asked Death for an unbeatable wand and was murdered for it in his sleep soon after boasting of his invincibility.

name: Cadmus Peverell
title: The Second Brother
description: The second Peverell brother, who asked Death for a stone to recall the dead, but was driven to despair by the loveless shade it returned to him and took his own life to join her properly.

name: Ignotus Peverell
title: The Youngest Brother
description: The wisest Peverell brother, who asked Death for a means to hide from it, lived a full and humble mortal life beneath the Cloak of Invisibility, and greeted Death as an old friend at the end.

name: Godric Gryffindor
title: Founder of Gryffindor House
description: One of the four founders of Hogwarts, who valued courage and daring above all in his students and whose sword can only be drawn by a true Gryffindor in need.

name: Helga Hufflepuff
title: Founder of Hufflepuff House
description: One of the four founders of Hogwarts, prized for her fairness and refusal to turn away any student, who hid one of her prized possessions as a cup later corrupted into a Horcrux.

name: Rowena Ravenclaw
title: Founder of Ravenclaw House
description: One of the four founders of Hogwarts, who valued learning and wit above all, and whose lost diadem was recovered centuries later after being turned into a Horcrux.

name: Salazar Slytherin
title: Founder of Slytherin House
description: One of the four founders of Hogwarts, who believed only pure-blood wizards should be taught magic and secretly built a hidden chamber beneath the school containing a monster to purge it of those he deemed unworthy.

name: Harry Potter
title: The Boy Who Lived
description: An orphaned wizard who survived Lord Voldemort's killing curse as an infant, was raised in ignorance of his fame by his Muggle relatives, and ultimately defeated the Dark Lord for good at the Battle of Hogwarts.

name: Hermione Granger
title: The Brightest Witch of Her Age
description: A brilliant Muggle-born witch whose mastery of magic, logic, and research repeatedly saves her friends, and who later becomes a leading voice for magical creature rights and Ministry reform.

name: Ron Weasley
title: The Loyal Best Friend
description: The youngest Weasley son, whose loyalty, chess strategy, and willingness to sacrifice himself prove crucial to the trio's survival despite his own insecurities about living in famous shadows.

name: Ginny Weasley
title: Gryffindor Chaser and Seeker
description: The youngest Weasley and only daughter, a formidable witch and Quidditch player who survives possession by Voldemort's diary Horcrux as a child and later marries Harry Potter.

name: Fred Weasley
title: Co-founder of Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes
description: One of the Weasley twins, an irrepressible prankster and inventor who fights in the Battle of Hogwarts alongside his family and dies in the final assault on the castle.

name: George Weasley
title: Co-founder of Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes
description: One of the Weasley twins, who builds a joke-shop empire with his brother Fred and carries on the business alone after Fred's death at the Battle of Hogwarts.

name: Percy Weasley
title: Ministry Official
description: The ambitious middle Weasley son who estranges himself from his family to climb the Ministry ladder, only to return in time to fight and reconcile at the Battle of Hogwarts.

name: Bill Weasley
title: Curse-Breaker for Gringotts
description: The eldest Weasley son, a curse-breaker scarred by the werewolf Fenrir Greyback during the Battle of the Astronomy Tower, who marries Fleur Delacour.

name: Charlie Weasley
title: Dragonologist
description: The second-eldest Weasley son, who studies and tends dragons in Romania and returns to help defend Hogwarts in the final battle.

name: Arthur Weasley
title: Head of the Weasley Family
description: A Ministry employee fascinated by Muggle artifacts who welcomes Harry into his large, loving family and later helps lead resistance to the Death Eater-controlled Ministry.

name: Molly Weasley
title: Matriarch of the Weasley Family
description: The fiercely protective mother of seven who treats Harry as her own son and duels Bellatrix Lestrange to the death at the Battle of Hogwarts after she threatens Ginny.

name: Neville Longbottom
title: Herbology Master and Dumbledore's Army Leader
description: An initially timid classmate whose courage grows across the series until he leads the resistance within Hogwarts in Harry's absence and slays Voldemort's serpent Nagini.

name: Luna Lovegood
title: The Quibbler's Daughter
description: An eccentric, dreamy Ravenclaw who sees the world differently from her peers, is unfailingly loyal to Harry, and fights alongside Dumbledore's Army at the Ministry and Hogwarts.

name: Cedric Diggory
title: Hogwarts Triwizard Champion
description: The popular, fair-minded Hufflepuff champion of the Triwizard Tournament, murdered by Peter Pettigrew on Voldemort's order the moment they touch the Triwizard Cup together.

name: James Potter
title: Harry's Father
description: A talented Gryffindor and founding member of the Marauders who married Lily Evans and died defending his infant son from Voldemort at Godric's Hollow.

name: Lily Potter
title: Harry's Mother
description: A brilliant Muggle-born witch whose self-sacrifice to protect baby Harry from Voldemort's curse created a protective enchantment that saved his life and nearly destroyed the Dark Lord.

name: Sirius Black
title: The Last Black Heir
description: Harry's godfather and a founding Marauder, wrongly imprisoned in Azkaban for twelve years for a betrayal actually committed by Peter Pettigrew, who dies at the Department of Mysteries.

name: Remus Lupin
title: Defence Against the Dark Arts Professor
description: A gentle, self-doubting werewolf and founding Marauder who teaches Harry to conjure a Patronus, joins the Order of the Phoenix, and dies at the Battle of Hogwarts alongside his wife Tonks.

name: Petunia Dursley
title: Harry's Aunt
description: Lily Potter's Muggle sister, resentful of magic and her sister's gifts, who reluctantly shelters Harry through his childhood under an ancient blood protection.

name: Vernon Dursley
title: Harry's Uncle
description: Petunia's blustering Muggle husband, fiercely intolerant of magic, who tries throughout Harry's childhood to suppress any sign of his nephew's wizarding heritage.

name: Dudley Dursley
title: Harry's Cousin
description: The spoiled only child of Vernon and Petunia, cruel to Harry throughout their childhood, who shows a flicker of gratitude after Harry saves him from Dementors.

name: Albus Dumbledore
title: Headmaster of Hogwarts
description: Widely regarded as the greatest wizard of his age, the Headmaster of Hogwarts who defeated Gellert Grindelwald in 1945, mentors Harry from afar, and orchestrates his own death at Severus Snape's hand to protect Draco Malfoy's soul.

name: Minerva McGonagall
title: Deputy Headmistress of Hogwarts
description: The stern but fair Transfiguration professor and Head of Gryffindor House, who defends Hogwarts against the Carrow siblings and leads the school's defense at the Battle of Hogwarts.

name: Severus Snape
title: Potions Master and Headmaster
description: A former Death Eater turned secret double agent for Dumbledore out of enduring love for Lily Potter, who spends the series appearing to torment Harry while quietly protecting him at every turn.

name: Rubeus Hagrid
title: Keeper of Keys and Grounds
description: The half-giant Keeper of Keys and Grounds at Hogwarts, expelled as a student but reinstated as Care of Magical Creatures professor, who rescued baby Harry from Godric's Hollow and remains his loyal friend.

name: Filius Flitwick
title: Charms Professor, Head of Ravenclaw
description: The diminutive Charms Master and Head of Ravenclaw House, who helps raise Hogwarts's magical defenses ahead of the Battle of Hogwarts.

name: Pomona Sprout
title: Herbology Professor, Head of Hufflepuff
description: The Herbology professor and Head of Hufflepuff House, who arms students with Venomous Tentacula pods and Mandrakes to defend the castle in the final battle.

name: Horace Slughorn
title: Potions Professor
description: A talent-collecting former Potions Master lured out of retirement by Dumbledore, whose altered memory of a fateful conversation with young Tom Riddle proves crucial to defeating Voldemort.

name: Alastor Moody
title: Auror and Defence Professor
description: A famously paranoid, battle-scarred Auror and Order of the Phoenix member, impersonated for a full year by Barty Crouch Jr. via Polyjuice Potion, and later killed during the Battle over Little Whinging.

name: Dolores Umbridge
title: High Inquisitor of Hogwarts
description: A sadistic Ministry bureaucrat installed as Defence Against the Dark Arts professor and High Inquisitor, who persecutes Harry and Dumbledore's Army before later serving the Death Eater-controlled Ministry.

name: Gilderoy Lockhart
title: Defence Against the Dark Arts Professor
description: A vain, fraudulent celebrity author who takes credit for other wizards' heroic deeds, until his own bungled memory charm backfires and erases his mind.

name: Argus Filch
title: Hogwarts Caretaker
description: The perpetually irritable Squib caretaker of Hogwarts, forever hunting for students out of bed with the help of his cat Mrs Norris.

name: Nymphadora Tonks
title: Auror of the Order of the Phoenix
description: A Metamorphmagus Auror and Order of the Phoenix member who marries Remus Lupin despite her family's disapproval and dies alongside him at the Battle of Hogwarts.

name: Kingsley Shacklebolt
title: Minister for Magic
description: A calm, capable Auror and Order of the Phoenix member who helps coordinate resistance to Voldemort and is appointed Minister for Magic after the war.

name: Lord Voldemort
title: The Dark Lord
description: Born Tom Marvolo Riddle, the most feared dark wizard of the age, who split his soul into seven Horcruxes in his quest for immortality and was ultimately destroyed by his own rebounding curse at the Battle of Hogwarts.

name: Bellatrix Lestrange
title: Voldemort's Most Loyal Servant
description: A fanatically devoted Death Eater and the Black family's most ruthless daughter, who tortured the Longbottoms into insanity and is killed dueling Molly Weasley at the Battle of Hogwarts.

name: Lucius Malfoy
title: Death Eater and Ministry Governor
description: A wealthy, influential Death Eater and Hogwarts governor who smuggles Tom Riddle's diary to a young Ginny Weasley and falls from Voldemort's favor after repeated failures.

name: Narcissa Malfoy
title: Matriarch of the Malfoy Family
description: Bellatrix's sister and Draco's protective mother, whose lie to Voldemort that Harry is dead in the Forbidden Forest, told only to find her own son, turns the tide of the final battle.

name: Draco Malfoy
title: Slytherin Prince
description: Harry's status-obsessed Slytherin rival, pressured into becoming a Death Eater and tasked with killing Dumbledore, who ultimately cannot bring himself to kill and survives the war disillusioned.

name: Peter Pettigrew
title: The Traitor
description: A cowardly Marauder who betrayed James and Lily Potter's location to Voldemort, framed Sirius Black for the crime, and hid for years disguised as the Weasleys' pet rat before his own silver hand strangles him.

name: Barty Crouch Jr.
title: Death Eater in Disguise
description: A fanatical Death Eater who impersonates Alastor Moody for a full school year via Polyjuice Potion to manipulate Harry through the Triwizard Tournament and deliver him to Voldemort.

name: Viktor Krum
title: Durmstrang Champion
description: A world-famous Bulgarian Seeker and Durmstrang's Triwizard champion, whose friendship with Hermione Granger, begun at the Yule Ball, endures long after the tournament.

name: Fleur Delacour
title: Beauxbatons Champion
description: A part-Veela witch and Beauxbatons's Triwizard champion, who falls in love with Bill Weasley during his recovery from a werewolf attack and marries him despite his family's initial doubts.

name: Gellert Grindelwald
title: The Dark Wizard Who Sought the Hallows
description: A brilliant, charismatic dark wizard who was Albus Dumbledore's closest friend and ideological ally in youth before pursuing wizarding domination in the name of 'the greater good,' ultimately imprisoned in his own fortress after their 1945 duel.

name: Dobby
title: The Free Elf
description: A house-elf once enslaved by the Malfoy family, freed by a trick of Harry's, who repeatedly risks himself to protect Harry and dies rescuing him and his friends from Malfoy Manor.

name: Kreacher
title: Black Family Elf
description: The bitter, tradition-bound house-elf of the Black family, initially resentful of his master Sirius, who becomes fiercely devoted to Harry after learning the truth about Regulus Black's death.

name: Buckbeak
title: The Proud Hippogriff
description: A proud hippogriff sentenced to execution after injuring the insolent Draco Malfoy, rescued by Harry and Hermione using a Time-Turner, and later ridden by Sirius Black to escape Hogwarts.

name: Fawkes
title: Dumbledore's Phoenix
description: Albus Dumbledore's loyal phoenix familiar, whose healing tears save Harry from Basilisk venom in the Chamber of Secrets and whose song bolsters courage in the darkest moments.

name: Aragog
title: Lord of the Forbidden Forest Spiders
description: A giant, sentient Acromantula raised secretly by young Hagrid, who commands a colony of monstrous spiders deep in the Forbidden Forest and nearly has Harry and Ron devoured.

name: Nagini
title: Voldemort's Serpent
description: Lord Voldemort's giant snake and constant companion, secretly turned into his final Horcrux, beheaded by Neville Longbottom with the Sword of Gryffindor during the Battle of Hogwarts.

name: The Basilisk
title: The Serpent of Slytherin
description: A giant serpent bred in secret by Salazar Slytherin and unleashed from the Chamber of Secrets by Tom Riddle's diary, whose gaze kills and whose fang later destroys one of Voldemort's Horcruxes.

name: Fluffy
title: The Three-Headed Guardian
description: A monstrous three-headed dog owned by Hagrid and used by Dumbledore to guard the Philosopher's Stone, easily lulled to sleep by music.

name: The Dementors
title: Guards of Azkaban
description: Soul-consuming dark creatures that feed on human happiness, traditionally used to guard Azkaban prison until they defect to Voldemort's side during his second rise.

name: Griphook
title: Gringotts Goblin
description: A goblin employee of Gringotts Wizarding Bank who reluctantly aids Harry, Ron, and Hermione in breaking into the Lestranges' vault before betraying them at a crucial moment.

name: Firenze
title: Centaur of the Forbidden Forest
description: A centaur banished by his herd for consorting with humans after rescuing Harry from Voldemort in the Forbidden Forest, who later teaches Divination at Hogwarts.

name: Hedwig
title: Harry's Snowy Owl
description: Harry's devoted snowy owl, a gift from Hagrid on his eleventh birthday, killed shielding him during the flight from Privet Drive at the start of the final war.

name: Thestrals
title: Death-Sighted Steeds
description: Skeletal, winged horses visible only to those who have witnessed death, who pull the Hogwarts carriages unseen and later carry Harry's friends to the Ministry of Magic.

name: Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry
title: School of Witchcraft and Wizardry
description: The great magical boarding school of Britain, founded a thousand years ago by Godric Gryffindor, Helga Hufflepuff, Rowena Ravenclaw, and Salazar Slytherin, and the site of the final Battle of Hogwarts.

name: Hogsmeade
title: The Only All-Wizarding Village in Britain
description: A charming village near Hogwarts, entirely populated by wizards, home to Honeydukes, the Three Broomsticks, and the Shrieking Shack.

name: Diagon Alley
title: Wizarding Shopping Street
description: A hidden cobbled street in London accessible through the Leaky Cauldron, lined with wizarding shops including Ollivanders wand shop and the entrance to Gringotts bank.

name: Knockturn Alley
title: Diagon Alley's Dark Twin
description: A dim, disreputable side street off Diagon Alley specializing in Dark artifacts and cursed objects, frequented by those with less savory purposes.

name: The Burrow
title: Home of the Weasley Family
description: The Weasley family's ramshackle, magically extended home in the countryside, a warm refuge for Harry throughout the series.

name: Privet Drive
title: Harry's Childhood Home
description: A painfully ordinary suburban street in Little Whinging where Harry is raised by the Dursleys, protected by an ancient blood ward tied to his mother's sacrifice.

name: Godric's Hollow
title: Birthplace of the Potters
description: A small West Country village where James and Lily Potter were killed by Voldemort, and where Harry's parents lie buried.

name: The Ministry of Magic
title: Seat of Wizarding Government
description: The governing body of the British wizarding world, headquartered in an underground complex in London, infiltrated and controlled by Voldemort's forces during the final war.

name: Azkaban
title: Wizarding Prison
description: A forbidding island fortress in the North Sea that holds the wizarding world's most dangerous criminals, once guarded by soul-draining Dementors.

name: Gringotts Wizarding Bank
title: Wizarding Bank
description: The goblin-run wizarding bank beneath Diagon Alley, renowned for its impenetrable vaults and guarded in its depths by a chained dragon.

name: The Forbidden Forest
title: The Dark Forest of Hogwarts Grounds
description: An ancient, dangerous forest bordering the Hogwarts grounds, home to centaurs, giant spiders, and unicorns, off-limits to students.

name: The Shrieking Shack
title: The Most Haunted Building in Britain
description: A dilapidated house at the edge of Hogsmeade, reputed as haunted, actually built to hide Remus Lupin's werewolf transformations, and later the site of Severus Snape's death.

name: Platform Nine and Three-Quarters
title: Gateway to Hogwarts
description: A hidden platform at King's Cross Station, accessible by walking through a solid barrier, from which the Hogwarts Express departs each September.

name: 12 Grimmauld Place
title: Headquarters of the Order of the Phoenix
description: The gloomy ancestral London townhouse of the Black family, inherited by Sirius Black and used as the secret headquarters of the Order of the Phoenix.

name: Malfoy Manor
title: Seat of the Malfoy Family
description: The grand ancestral home of the Malfoy family, used by Voldemort as a base of operations and prison for captives during the final war.

name: Durmstrang Institute
title: Northern Wizarding School
description: A wizarding school somewhere in Northern Europe known for its emphasis on the Dark Arts, whose students compete in the Triwizard Tournament.

name: Beauxbatons Academy of Magic
title: French Wizarding Academy
description: An elegant French wizarding school that competes alongside Hogwarts and Durmstrang in the Triwizard Tournament.

name: The Chamber of Secrets
title: Slytherin's Hidden Chamber
description: A hidden chamber beneath Hogwarts built by Salazar Slytherin, home to a Basilisk meant to purge the school of Muggle-born students.

name: The Department of Mysteries
title: The Unspeakables' Domain
description: A secretive Ministry of Magic department researching death, time, thought, and prophecy, and the site of Sirius Black's death during a Death Eater ambush.

name: Nurmengard
title: Grindelwald's Fortress-Prison
description: A grim mountain fortress built by Gellert Grindelwald to house his enemies, ironically becoming his own prison after his defeat by Albus Dumbledore.
